# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 107 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 107

Jesus said: "The kingdom is like a shepherd who had a hundred sheep. The largest one strayed. He left the ninety-nine behind and searched until he found it. When he had put himself through all that trouble, he said to the sheep: 'I love you more than the ninety-nine.'"

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "The largest one strayed" — the size/value emphasized
- "Left the ninety-nine behind" — the deliberate abandonment of the majority
- "Put himself through all that trouble" — the personal cost of the search
